policy.purpose: Store reviewed observations that cannot yet be obtained from an automated primary-source adapter.
rules: Do not enter a value from memory or from an uncited secondary summary.
Use one record per value, period, scope, source, and revision.
Each record requires value or at least one of value_low and value_high.
Guidance ranges use value_low and value_high; do not replace a range with an undocumented midpoint.
Consensus values must identify the provider and observation timestamp.
Internal estimates and scenarios must include model_id, formula or assumptions, and evidence_ids.
A correction supersedes an earlier record through supersedes_id; history is never deleted silently.
